name: Para-bromoamphetamine
summary: para-Bromoamphetamine (PBA), also known as 4-bromoamphetamine (4-BA), is an amphetamine derivative which acts as a serotonin-norepinephrine-dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA) and produces stimulant effects.

pharmacology.text: PBA has been found to be a monoamine oxidase A (MAO-A) inhibitor, with an IC50 of 1,500 nM.

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study how monoamines are released. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於探討單胺的釋放機制，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于探讨单胺的释放机制，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Its close relatives para-chloroamphetamine and para-iodoamphetamine damage serotonin nerve endings in animals. Strong serotonin release can cause serotonin syndrome with high body temperature and agitation.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它的近親 4-氯苯丙胺與 4-碘苯丙胺在動物實驗中會損傷血清素神經末梢。強烈的血清素釋放可能造成血清素症候群，伴隨高體溫與躁動。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它的近亲 4-氯苯丙胺与 4-碘苯丙胺在动物实验中会损伤血清素神经末梢。强烈的血清素释放可能造成血清素症候群，伴随高体温与躁动。

fact.en: Adding a bromine atom at the far end of amphetamine's ring shifts its action strongly towards serotonin, which is a general pattern in this family.
fact.zh: 在安非他命環的末端位置加上一個溴原子，會使它的作用大幅偏向血清素，這是這個家族的普遍規律。
fact.zhHans: 在安非他命环的末端位置加上一个溴原子，会使它的作用大幅偏向血清素，这是这个家族的普遍规律。
